audio_description:
A missile cuts across the sky.
Rinoa stands on Balamb Garden's deck, hair streaming, watching the attack.
Winged cruise missiles swarm around the Garden's structure.
They burst against the hull as the mobile academy runs the gauntlet.

context.scene_title: The missile assault on Balamb Garden — Rinoa watches from the deck as the missiles close in (Disc 2).
locations: Balamb Garden's exterior deck/balcony and the surrounding sky

characters.name: Rinoa Heartilly
characters.recognition: Young woman with long dark hair, pale-blue knit top over a black top, silver ring necklace and blue arm-warmers; stands at the Garden's railing looking up at the attack.

characters.name: (Galbadian cruise missiles)
characters.recognition: Winged finned missiles swarming the Garden's hull and exploding against it.

context.summary: As a missile cuts across the sky, Rinoa stands on Balamb Garden's deck, hair streaming, watching the attack. Winged cruise missiles swarm in around the Garden's structure, bursting against the hull as the mobile academy runs the gauntlet.
context.context_note: High confidence: Rinoa on the Garden deck during the cruise-missile attack.
